chapters.title: TURNED AT THE 00
chapters.text: The bar reached 26,600, the gold 00 that starts the block, and closed back above it, 7.75 points clear.

chapters.title: ABOVE THE 50
chapters.text: The bar closed above 26,650, the platinum 50 at the middle of the block. Next on the map above: 26,680, the 80.

chapters.title: ABOVE THE 00
chapters.text: The bar closed above 26,700, the gold 00 that starts a new block. Next on the map above: 26,720, the 20.

chapters.title: TURNED AT THE 00
chapters.text: Back at 26,700, the gold 00 it closed above 14 bars earlier: the bar reaches it and closes back above it, 6.75 points clear.
